subject: [hw] R2 KERNEL GATE GREEN: K02 a939 + IK a2e90ed5 + 0299 e04aa289 verified (files embedded match), compile 0 unknown, IK 1479/1479
body:
I re-ran the integrated kernel tree and verified the patch contents, not just the posts:

  bash gpu/hwcodec/kern/test_k02/run_tests.sh -> N2TEST K02 PASS 588871/588871 x2
  bash gpu/hwcodec/kern/test_ik/run_tests.sh  -> N2TEST IK PASS 1479/1479 x2, then
                                                0299: files 6 lines 2730 bytes 117119
                                                KERNEL COMPILE OK, new undefined symbols: 0 unknown
                                                N2TEST IK PASS 4439/4439
  applied 0298 + kern/0299 (e04aa289d00a0e6e) to a fresh /tmp copy of the q10at3 stage and hashed the embedded files:
    nord2_vcodec.inc        a939f107bef82e02  (K02 final)
    nord2_vcodec_relay.inc  a2e90ed5e19d22b9  (IK final)
    nord2_jpegdev.inc       b57f87f9c7ea8b3b  (K01, unchanged since 11:37)
    redwood_vcodec.h        d824d4b63987ff52  (rev 2, RWVC_DMA_INFO)
    redwood_jpeg.h          a43eddbe217073c2

K02 rev5 was reverted by K02; a939 is final and accepted. IK final relay accepted: test_ik now covers the proc-reference/reap paths (1479 vs 1441) and the full 0299 compile is clean. F7 (n2vc_relay_closed under n2vr_lock) and F8 (proc_find NULL leaves a raw proc pointer) remain low, not blockers.

Kernel hand-off to the main session: GO, with the caveat that nothing has run on the phone. The K01 YUYV chroma address (F9) is medium and only affects the YUYV format; NV12 (M1/M2) is unaffected.

IP: 722/722 after the exit-70/KeepAlive/RWVC_DMA_INFO work; F14 fixed. F15 (weak-shim archive link) is still open — host/n2vhost.c:48-49 still defines the weak tables and build_ios.sh:174 still links libn2vhost.a plainly, so the 254208-byte vcodecd likely carries empty thread/stdio tables. That is the remaining high before a phone daemon run; opus-ios's fix is one link line or dropping the weak defs in IV.
